column1: # PS-100: pokefirered special -> what the imported scripts call here. Columns: FRLG name, action, note.
# Actions: same (the same name exists here with the same meaning; a special with the same name and no row is
# treated as 'same' too), =Name (an Emerald twin under another name), stub:KantoName (a no-op / constant from
# src/kanto_specials.c), port:KantoName (rewritten from pokefirered in src/kanto_specials.c, `// PS-100:` names
# the FRLG function). Every stub and port must be registered in data/specials.inc. PS-101 completes the table.
# --- the PS-100 slice (Pallet Town / Route 1 / Viridian City) ---
